items.text: Thankful for the chance to join the hardworking members of the National Association of Insurance & Financial Advisors-Pineywoods of East Texas at their membership luncheon. Last week, I sat down with the President of Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, Jim Springfield, and some of the many BCBS Texas employees that work and live in the Marshall area to discuss the evolving landscape of healthcare in our state. Thank you BCBS Marshall for your service! https://t.co/hQkaWD0rds

Earlier this week, I had an informative chat with Mark Leitner, CEO for UT Health Henderson & Carthage. We discussed UT Health’s role in the East Texas community and their commitment to advancing affordable and accessible healthcare for those living in rural areas. Thank you! https://t.co/taCXabd6xU

Earlier this month, I toured Hospitality Health’s ER facility in Tyler, TX where I was encouraged once more by the dedication of medical professionals in East Texas, but dismayed by the roadblocks the federal government puts up that works against patient care. https://t.co/7fZYe8PsN1

The American Cancer Society plays a pivotal role in advocating for legislation that increases research into possible cancer treatments. Thank you for your dedication to improving access to quality cancer treatment and supporting cancer patients and their families. https://t.co/Svlwm63meu

@michaelcburgess’ bill represents a crucial step towards improving access to preventive healthcare services and addressing healthcare costs for Americans. This bill will help Congress cut costs for patients and increase transparency in our nation's healthcare system. https://t.co/76uA3VZzA4

On Monday, I had the privilege of visiting the Wadley Regional Medical Center in Texarkana, TX. Thank you for all you do to respond to the needs of our communities and provide life-saving care to the residents of #TX01. https://t.co/HRl6h3FWM3

I appreciated the opportunity to witness firsthand the crucial work home health providers do for patients in East Texas. I look forward to continuing to support their important efforts here and across the country! https://t.co/AHggHzPi9X

JUST PASSED: @RepTiffany's No WHO Pandemic Preparedness Treaty Without Senate Approval Act. I was proud to cosponsor this bill which ensures that any pandemic-related convention by the World Health Organization MUST be considered and ratified by the Senate as a treaty. 

We must defend U.S. sovereignty and keep crucial decisions where they belong—within our control.

On National First Responders Day, we honor the bravery of police officers, firefighters, paramedics, 911 dispatchers, and medical professionals who risk their lives daily to protect and serve our communities. Today, we recognize their critical role and remember those who have lost their lives in the line of duty. You are true examples of heroes to your community!
Thank you to @TexasCHCs for a great conversation about their work to support thriving community health centers and ensure quality care for Texans. https://t.co/ATVsa6nx2R

I am incredibly honored by the trust my colleagues have placed in me by selecting me as a member of the Ways and Means Committee for the 119th Congress.

From tax policy to healthcare to trade matters, the Ways and Means Committee touches countless areas impacting East Texans and the First District of Texas.

I look forward to the work ahead as we extend the Trump Tax Cuts, reignite our economy, and promote polices that benefit Texas families, taxpayers, and small businesses.

During last week's @WaysandMeansGOP Work and Welfare Subcommittee hearing, I raised concerns about China’s role in American unemployment insurance fraud. As a member of both the Ways and Means Committee and the @committeeonccp, I’m committed to rooting out fraud that hurts Americans—both foreign and domestic.

Saddened to hear of the passing of my dear friend, Sheriff Tom Maddox. His kindness, dedication, and love for the local community will not be forgotten. My prayers are with his family and loved ones. https://t.co/gFeIsMBKcI

Big news for TX-01: Smith County and the City of Tyler have been recognized as a Veteran-Friendly Community by the East Texas Council of Governments!

This incredible designation honors the community’s efforts to support our veterans with resources in housing, healthcare, transportation, education, and more. Thank you to all who have worked to make this achievement possible. Let's continue supporting our heroes who have given so much for our freedom!  🇺🇸 https://t.co/KRPO03gLxd

It was a privilege to visit @UTTylerNursing during National Nurses Week and speak with students preparing to serve others through one of the most noble professions. Their commitment, compassion, and calling will bring health and healing to East Texas for generations to come.

The “Texas Thriving Families” program is on track to help nearly 45,000 moms with housing, healthcare, and job training, backed by $15 million in state support.

This is what pro-life policy should look like. The result is hope and life.

Great to meet with Clinical Speciality Infusions Pharmacy, who provide service every day to patients with chronic and rare illnesses, requiring complex care.

Their work has helped countless individuals and their families. Great to look at new ways we can provide support to those who have rare diseases and their support systems.

Democrats are threatening to shut down the government unless Republicans agree to pour billions more into Obamacare subsidies—taxpayer dollars that prop up rising insurance costs and mainly benefit insurance companies, not families. These subsidies are set to expire at the end of 2025 because Democrats wrote that expiration into law. Now they want to pretend otherwise and are willing to hold the government hostage to hide the truth.
Instead of funding our troops, border security, or critical services, Democrats are drawing a red line over subsidies for insurance companies. That tells you everything about their priorities.
